notes.subject: גאון הירדן
notes.rationale: gowa/praipela hap bilong Yarden (ol bus na wara i go antap long taim bilong ren) o gowa bilong man — JPS 'thickets', KJV 'swelling'

notes.subject: נוה איתן
notes.rationale: ples bilong stap we i strongpela: habitasyon bilong Edom i strongpela, o gaden gris we i stap olgeta taim (BSB 'watered pasture')

notes.subject: laion
notes.rationale: husat em i laion — Nemesis (Babel) we i kamap, o Yahwe yet; KJV/ASV i ting em i narapela, YLT i litim stret

notes.subject: ol kwesten long ves
notes.rationale: tripela kwesten — husat i olsem mi, husat i makim taim bilong mi, husat po man i lukautim sipsip i ken sanap — i toktok kros long ol man i laik kot wantaim Yahwe

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim objekt long 'em i lusim', Hebrew i gat tausol מעליה

translation: Lukluk, em i kamap olsem laion, i antap long gowa bilong Yarden, i go long ples bilong stap we i strongpela; bikos bai mi mekim em i ranawe stat, em i lusim ⟨em⟩ olgeta; na husat man ol i makim, bai mi bilip long en? Bikos husat i olsem mi? Na husat i makim taim bilong mi? Na husat dispela man i lukautim ol sipsip, we i ken sanap pastaim long mi?

tokens.gloss: bai mi mekim em i ranawe stat
bai mi salim em i ran
